title: Boston Blackie
paragraphs: Crime adventures featuring Boston Blackie, a former jewel thief who uses his underworld knowledge to solve cases while frequently crossing paths with police Inspector Faraday.
Crime-mystery series about reformed jewel thief Boston Blackie. Mary Wesley performer attribution is source-disputed across surviving logs, contemporary trade material, and later reference histories.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: NBC West Coast summer cycle (June 23, 1944 to September 15, 1944) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], NBC Chester Morris era (June 23, 1944 to September 15, 1944) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and Ziv syndicated Richard Kollmar era (April 11, 1945 to October 25, 1950).

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Henry Sylvern (organist), Jeanne Harrison (director), Lesley Woods (performer), [[person|maurice-tarplin|Maurice Tarplin]] (performer), [[person|richard-kollmar|Richard Kollmar]] (performer), Chester Morris (performer), and [[person|frank-lovejoy|Frank Lovejoy]] (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.070a5b7dde24b155|Ziv]], [[org|org.09b709d4bde5c263|Mutual Broadcasting System]], [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].
The stories often return to murder and homicide, murder investigations, jewel and diamond crime, theft, burglary and robbery, jewelry, gems and valuable property, and police investigation.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Boston Blackie from Jack Boyle fiction into screen and radio, Frederic W. Ziv transcription syndication model, Boston Blackie television continuation, and Boston Blackie as a cross-media crime character.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|cbs-radio-workshop|CBS Radio Workshop]], [[show|columbia-workshop|Columbia Workshop]], and [[show|gang-busters|Gang Busters]].
